name: CR-Int-15-partialfrac-6
generalfeedback:
In order to calculate \[\int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}}\] we need to express \[{{CT:0}}\] as the sum of its partial fractions <hint>alg_partial_fractions</hint>.

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 {{CT:0}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:2}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:3}}{{CT:4}} + {{CT:5}}{{CT:6}} + {{CT:7}}{{CT:8}}
 \end{array}\]

By multiplying both sides by {{CT:9}} we get

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 {{CT:10}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:11}} + {{CT:12}} + {{CT:13}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:14}}
 \end{array}\]

Equating coefficients of {{CT:15}} we get a system of equations that can be solved to get \(A = {{CT:16}}\), \(B = {{CT:17}}\) and \(C = {{CT:18}}\).

So, \[{{CT:0}} = {{CT:19}}\]

Hence,

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \int {{CT:19}} d{{CT:1}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:16}} \int {{CT:4}} d{{CT:1}} + {{CT:17}} \int {{CT:6}} d{{CT:1}} + {{CT:18}} \int {{CT:8}} d{{CT:1}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:20}} + {{CT:21}} + {{CT:22}} +c \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:23}} +c
 \end{array}\]
